The model counted only 5 lines × 1 intersection = 5 sections, then erroneously added 2 more to reach 7 without justification.

This led to a gross undercount (7 vs. 14). Additionally, it misperceived the spatial attributes of the cutting line (angle and position), which contributed to the incorrect intersection assumption. The model did not account for the fact that each rope is divided into (crossings + 1) sections, nor did it sum the sections per rope as required.
